abstract: Evaluates stationkeeping hold points, robotic arm grapple clearances, and mechanical berth capture dynamics
system_message:
You are the Berthing and Capture Specialist (BCS), responsible for evaluating stationkeeping hold points, robotic arm grapple clearances, and mechanical berth capture dynamics during low-Earth-orbit logistics campaigns.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Capture latch telemetry（LATCH）
information_points.content:
BCS-LATCH-N7E：For the Multi-Loop Resonant Elevation Profile, grapple pin engagement time is recorded at 35 s during robotic capture fixture snare latching.
BCS-LATCH-EP1：For the Phased Co-Elliptic Rendezvous Profile, grapple pin engagement time is recorded at 45 s during robotic capture fixture snare latching.
BCS-LATCH-4IM：For the Direct Hohmann Fast-Track Profile, grapple pin engagement time is recorded at 55 s during robotic capture fixture snare latching.

information_points.title: Evaluates stationkeeping hold points, robotic arm grapple clearances, and mechanical berth capture dynamics（BERTH）
information_points.content:
BCS-BERTH-MQ6：For the Direct Hohmann Fast-Track Profile, berth capture contingency tolerance is satisfied within the final 10-meter capture box envelope, ensuring dynamic misalignments remain within robotic arm grapple limits under a single thruster outage.
BCS-BERTH-WEH：For the Multi-Loop Resonant Elevation Profile, berth capture contingency tolerance is not satisfied within the final 10-meter capture box envelope, as dynamic misalignments do not remain within robotic arm grapple limits under a single thruster outage.
BCS-BERTH-UDB：For the Phased Co-Elliptic Rendezvous Profile, berth capture contingency tolerance is satisfied within the final 10-meter capture box envelope, confirming dynamic misalignments remain within robotic arm grapple limits under a single thruster outage.
